description:
Fast, private Vietnamese keyboard (Telex/VNI) for Windows: no underline, no data collection.

VietTelex is a Vietnamese input method for Windows 10 and 11, built on the Text Services Framework (TSF) - the system keyboard API. It needs no global keyboard hook, so it also works in Chrome, Edge, Excel and Word, and in apps running as administrator.

- Telex or VNI, old or new tone placement, fix tones anywhere in the word.
- No underline while typing; Command Prompt, PowerShell and Windows Terminal included.
- Restores English words automatically and checks Vietnamese spelling.
- Custom shortcuts; remembers Vietnamese/English per app; Ctrl+Shift, Alt+Z or Win+Space to switch.
- Leaves password fields alone; turns itself off in Remote Desktop and virtual machines.
- Native x64 and ARM64 builds.

No telemetry: VietTelex collects no data and only goes online when you press Check for updates. Free and open source (MIT).
